title: Fifteen years of kept notes
subtitle: I've written down every sailing since 2011. This is what the record does for yours.

sub: Every sailing and ship visit since 2011 went into the notes the same day, before hindsight could tidy it up.

items.head: The ships
items.body: Where the noise travels, which cabins sit under the pool deck, and which suites are worth it.

items.head: The ports
items.body: How long the tender actually takes, and what time the crowds turn up.

items.head: The fares
items.body: What a sailing listed at, what it later sold for, and roughly when in the year the drop comes.

title: The notebook stays on my desk. You get its verdict.
caption: Fifteen years of it goes into every shortlist I send.
brief: Jordan's engraved portrait stamp, centred on white - composed 4:5 from public/portrait-engraved.png.

points.label: The ship
points.value: I compare it with its sister ships and check when it was last refitted.

points.label: The cabin
points.value: Picked off the deck plan, down to what's above and below it.

points.label: The season
points.value: Timed for the light and for how many other ships will be in port that day.

points.label: The fare
points.value: Negotiated from what sailings like it have actually sold for.

text: Plenty of people have sailed for fifteen years.
sub: Very few wrote any of it down. The notebook is what you get when you write to me.

title: Name a sailing you're weighing up
body: Ship and month is enough. Send it in a DM, and if the notebook has an opinion I'll give you the two-line verdict at no charge.
